`682-683`: ** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Unverified finding** Verification ran but could not confirm this finding. It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Keep provider usage with its generating call.** If two streams use one `GoogleLLM` instance, stream B can replace `_last_usage` while stream A is paused. If A then closes, its usage decorator claims B’s counts. B can subsequently fall back to estimated counts. Store or pass usage per call so each decorator claims only its own report. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arc53/DocsGPT/ce29128d7a34a806993a8445897658ce222d5546/docsgpt/llm/google_ai.py))
